patches.name: Show all brand accounts
patches.description: ArchiveTune's account switcher hides every account that YouTube reports as having no YouTube channel. Music-only brand accounts usually have none, so they never show up under "YouTube channels" in the account menu. This makes them show up.

patches.name: Sign in with microG
patches.description: Sign in with an account from microG (GmsCore) instead of typing a Google password. microG signs the login page in as the chosen account, then ArchiveTune's normal login flow runs, including YouTube Music's own main/brand account switcher.
